points.sentence: If they posted a comment to one of your posts, you have up to 7 days to send a single private reply/direct message to them.
Instagram limits who you can message and when: If they sent a direct message to you, you have 24 hours to respond to them.

verdict.reason: The entry says a private reply to an Instagram comment must go out within 7 days, and this comment is 9 days old, so it answers the customer's question.
